items.question: Who has Sug Sutton played for in the WNBA?
items.answer: Washington drafted Sug Sutton 36th overall in 2020. She has played for the Washington Mystics, the Phoenix Mercury (2023 and 2024), the Portland Fire, who took her in the 2026 expansion draft, and the Dallas Wings, who signed her in June 2026.

items.question: How did Sug Sutton play in 2026?
items.answer: In 2026, Sug Sutton averaged 11.3 points and 5.7 assists in three games for the Portland Fire before being waived on May 21. After signing with Dallas on June 14, she averaged 2.3 points and 1.5 assists in 22 games for the Wings.

items.question: How tall is Sug Sutton?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Sug Sutton at 5 feet 8 inches and 140 pounds.

items.question: Where did Sug Sutton play college basketball?
items.answer: Sug Sutton, a St. Louis native, played at Texas from 2016 to 2020, averaging 8.3 points and 3.2 assists in 131 games. She made the All-Big 12 Second Team in 2020.
